Modern Quilt Designer 0.8.0 Preview — mixed block sizes and fabric strips

Choose Quilt → Horizontal Bands & Strips or Vertical Bands & Strips. Set the finished span, add block bands or fabric strips, and edit size, count, alignment and fabrics in the right panel. Reorder, duplicate, Undo/Redo, Save and Open work with exact fractional measurements.

The same geometry drives the quilt, per-size cutting lists, yardage, My Blocks and numbered PDF assembly references. Strip-only quilts are supported. Existing blocks, drawing, fabrics, dark mode and older project formats retain their meaning.

Band projects use format 7 and need 0.8.0 or newer. Save a Copy before converting if you need to keep an older-app version. Freeform placement, layers/applique and automatic motif matching remain future work. Verify physical printing and sewing before commercial pattern use.

Install through Help → Check for Updates → Preview / Development → Download & install. The app saves your work and restarts; choose Restore design to continue. Installers are public; source remains private. This preview has update-signature verification but no Windows Authenticode certificate.
